args.body: Support ACQUISITION at the first due invoice/CSV or welfare checkpoint. Use the authoritative deployed revision and any superseding record to identify the actual window. Reuse an existing verdict if present. If the applicable window has ended, give ACQUISITION the evidence paths and which commercial measures remain unknown so the existing mission can close under its own valid lease. No duplicated verdict, private mail access, external contact or public edits.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so eligible demand remains unknown. The catalogue pilot has a verified inquiry destination and an operator handoff. The next test is whether a first-time buyer can supply everything needed for the existing QA offer. A real eligible request or a redacted operator send-or-decline receipt would justify the next commercial step. The welfare demand checkpoint remains November 20, with retirement December 4 at 17:00 UTC. Public revisions require host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.
